featureItems.title: Searchable Case Database
featureItems.description: Access a comprehensive database of reproductive justice cases across Africa.

featureItems.title: AI-Powered Analysis
featureItems.description: Leverage advanced AI to identify legal trends and patterns.

featureItems.title: Interactive Visualizations
featureItems.description: Explore data through dynamic charts and visual representations.

featureItems.title: Advanced Search
featureItems.description: Find relevant cases and documents with powerful search capabilities.

thematicItems.title: Access to Safe Abortion
thematicItems.description: Legal frameworks, barriers, and advancements in ensuring access to safe abortion services across Africa.

thematicItems.title: Maternal Health and Mortality
thematicItems.description: Cases addressing maternal healthcare access, quality of care, and accountability for preventable maternal deaths.

thematicItems.title: Sexual and Gender-Based Violence
thematicItems.description: Legal responses to SGBV, including rape, domestic violence, and their impact on reproductive health and rights.

thematicItems.title: Consent and Adolescent Rights
thematicItems.description: Legal issues surrounding consent for reproductive healthcare, particularly for adolescents and vulnerable populations.

thematicItems.title: Discrimination in Healthcare
thematicItems.description: Cases challenging discriminatory practices in reproductive healthcare delivery based on gender, disability, or socioeconomic status.

thematicItems.title: Menstrual Health and Hygiene
thematicItems.description: Legal advocacy for menstrual equity, including access to products, facilities, and education.

benefitItems.title: Legal Professionals
benefitItems.description: Access comprehensive case management tools and legal resources to effectively handle reproductive justice cases.

benefitItems.title: Policymakers
benefitItems.description: Make informed decisions with data-driven insights and trend analysis across multiple jurisdictions.

benefitItems.title: Activists
benefitItems.description: Stay informed about legal developments and collaborate with stakeholders to drive meaningful change.
